projects.name: Project sBilling
details: This project involves streamlining of the Billing process for major custodian bank via standardization and rolling out a
global integration platform for all the branches. The system is expected to have automated integration with the data
sources and interface the upstream systems. My role as a Business Analyst consists of the below:
• Writing test cases, user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Documenting the user manuals, system architecture, flow diagrams and sequence diagrams Creation of UAT test
data and staging the data for various fees charged.
• Performing testing in UAT environment.
• Obtaining sign offs from operations users.
• Working closely with development team to make sure requirements are well understood and propose solution and
discuss Pros and cons with the stakeholders and product owners.

projects.name: MCH is a multi-feature application, where the Client service teams can input and track the trades status as
details: SWIFT instruction process. Additional approval step is required for Cash and Security transactions due to regulatory and
business reasons. Project will benefit include replacing fax based manual instructions by SWIFT based STP leading to reduced operational risk and reduced processing time.
MCH provides all the transaction details to the user. The user can find both the cash payment SWIFTs
(MT202/MT103/MT210) & trade SWIFT proprietary message type called MT messages (MT-54x, MT-56x series).

projects.name: Trades risk: Introduced and implemented the functionalities in order to mitigate the risk of Potential Buy-in
details: trades loss for the clients. Detailed FRD was drafted and implemented to reduce the buy-in penalties risk for the APAC
clients (China, Singapore, Malaysia).
Sub-project - Instruct Lite: Instruct Lite is an application where client directly releases MT-599 Swifts for any
amendments to the State Streets sub-custodians.
Worked with the development team in order to set-up an application where Client wishes to process the payments/fund
injections via MT-599 (free format) instead of MT-202/MT-202 cov. The application works as viewer and checker for the
MT-599(free format).
Automation projects: Assisted onshore management in creating user stories for successful automation and implementation of
CSM tool.
Responsibilities:
• Implemented/enhanced functionalities for Trade settlement and recon team via STP/MT-54x series.
• Creation of FRD for Trade browsing, client facing team and Buy-in trades for Singapore & Malaysia markets.
• Create Business/Functional user stories.
• Review Product backlog with Product Owner and team.
• Writing test cases & test plans.
• Attend Daily Stand up, Sprint Review, Refinement & Retrospective meetings with Business & Technology. Escalate
any business or technology issues to senior management for timely solution.
• Raise bugs and defect management.
• JIRA Management.
• Creating Wireframes and process flows.

projects.name: This billing project focused on standardization of the billing tool for the various services provided by
details: BNY Mellon as a custodian. BNY Mellon charges various types of fees to its clients for the services provided. The user
of the FiRRe application can view and set up various fees that are being charged by BNY Mellon to its clients. The
billing cycles could be set up for each client as per Fee schedule/Custody agreements.
Tasks & Responsibilities:
• Requirements Gathering.
• Creation of process flows.
• Drafting Change requests.
• Real time Testing on tool.
• Operational Readiness Obtaining sign offs from stakeholders.
• Support after Implementation.
• Maintenance of Project SharePoint and Confluence pages.
• Daily, Weekly and Steer Co meeting reports and presentations.
